candidateCoverage.notes: Original 119 draft candidates were not independently all confirmed. Added 13 documented missing players, changed Di Livio CM to RW based lineup; Perugia/Roma Nakata transfer preserved as single player. Full team-level candidate re-selection and position audit remain pending.

meta.europeanQualificationReview: Nine actual competition entrants cross-checked with historical Serie A and European records including Inter play-off, Perugia and Udinese 2000 Intertoto. Club-by-club official UEFA citations and signoff pending.
meta.qualificationNotes: Inter entered UCL after play-off victory over Parma. Perugia and Udinese participated in 2000 Intertoto; Udinese subsequently won a UEFA Cup entry.
meta.candidateAuditNotes: Milan Maldini reassigned from LB to CB based on first-hand Roma historical analysis of Zaccheroni 3-back; Ayala with only 9 league starts removed from CB three-player shortlist. Roma Cafu, Zago and Zanetti DOB errors rectified against UEFA, Roma historical, official Inter sources. Verified 1999 Fiorentina/Udinese etc research continue; low-start RB Juventus (Birindelli4) and Perugia CB Rivalta7 removed, Colonnese replaced with Simić19.
meta.rolesSemantics: Candidate-slot starter is highest league-start player per fixed position; backup is secondary candidate slot even when historical co-starter. 2 CB starters and up to 1 backup; 2 CM starters and up to 1 backup provisionally. Historical actual formation exception may change positions/CM/CAM eligibility at signoff.
meta.formationReview: Representative late-1990s Serie A 4-3-1-2 proposed; actual league-modal formation not independently measured. Club-specific 3-4-1-2 patterns documented and preserved.

bestXiReview.method: Actual 1999-00 positions and individual contributions; prior years weighted lower; no team-trophy direct addition
bestXiReview.limitations: Global position ranking and three-season player-by-player audit remain partial. Best XI strictly provisional.

meta.historicalExceptionInterPlayoff: 2000 Inter-Parma play-off excluded from 34 league fixtures: Baggio 18/4 regular + playoff 1/2 = Inter official 19/6; Recoba 27/10 regular + playoff 1/0 = Inter official 28/10. Sources RSSSF player stats, Inter player official archives, FBref.
